newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 27.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - President Henri Konan Bedie, on his return from visits to China, Singapore and France, says his trip was productive. Says Singapore should be a model for Ivory Coast's economic capital Abidjan. LE JOUR - Ivorian Foreign Minister Amara Essy withdraws his candidacy for post of Organisation of African Unity Secretary General. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
